title: A Generative Sampler for distributions with possible discrete parameter based on Reversibility
summary: Learning to sample from complex unnormalized distributions is a fundamental challenge in computational physics and machine learning. While score-based and variational methods have achieved success in continuous domains, extending them to discrete or mixed-variable systems remains difficult due to ill-defined gradients or high variance in estimators. We propose a unified, target-gradient-free generative sampling framework applicable across diverse state spaces.
